title: 第15章 她也是有学霸包袱的好吗？
novel_title: 贵族学院平民盲女怎么成了白月光
content_zh:
叶闻白正站在衣帽间里换衣服，上身只穿了一件白衬衫，扣子还没扣好，露出一截精瘦的腰身。

    听到安怜的声音，他转过身，看到她只穿了一件吊带睡裙，头发散在肩上，脚上套着毛绒拖鞋，看起来乖乖的。

    “过来。”他说。

    安怜走过去，叶闻白从衣柜里拿出一件薄外套，披在她肩上。

    “早上凉，多穿点。”他说着，低头在她额头上亲了一下。

    安怜有些羞，脸颊也不受控制的发热，她小声说：“我又不是小孩子。”

    叶闻白唇角上扬，没说话，转身继续挑选今天要穿的领带。

    安怜站在旁边，虽然看不见，但她能感知到叶闻白在做什么。

    他的动作不急不慢，先拿出一条深蓝色的领带比了比，似乎不太满意，又放了回去，换了一条银灰色的，在领口比划。

    “哥哥今天要出门吗？”安怜问。

    “嗯，上午有个会。”叶闻白一边系领带一边说，“下午回来，陪你吃晚饭。”

    安怜乖巧地点头。

    叶闻白系好领带，转过身，看着安怜。

    她站在那里，披着他的外套，头发有点乱，脸上还带着刚睡醒的红晕。

    整个人看起来懒洋洋的，像一只餍足的小猫。

    叶闻白帮她把睡裙的领口往上拉了拉。

    昨晚留下的痕迹有些太明显了。

    安怜感觉到他的动作，脸颊又红了几分，小声嘟囔：“都怪你。”

    叶闻白挑眉：“怪我？”

    “当然怪你。”安怜理直气壮地说，“我都说了不要了，你还……”

    她说不下去了，声音越来越小。

    叶闻白看着她这副又羞又恼的模样，心情好极了，伸手揉了揉她的发顶。

    “好好好，怪我。”他说，“下次注意。”

    安怜哼了一声，偏过头不看他。

    虽然她本来也看不见。

    叶闻白收回手，走到床边坐下，拍了拍身边的位置。

    “过来坐。”

    安怜慢吞吞地走过去，在叶闻白身边坐下。
content_en:
Ye Wenbai was standing in the cloakroom changing clothes. He only wore a white shirt on his upper body, which was not buttoned yet, revealing a lean waist.

    Hearing An Lian's voice, he turned around and saw that she was only wearing a suspender nightgown, with her hair spread over her shoulders and plush slippers on her feet. She looked well-behaved.

    "Come here," he said.

    An Lian walked over, and Ye Wenbai took out a thin coat from the closet and put it on her shoulders.

    "It's cold in the morning, so wear more clothes." He said, lowering his head and kissing her on the forehead.

    An Lian was a little embarrassed, and her cheeks were heating up uncontrollably. She whispered, "I'm not a child."

    Ye Wenbai raised the corners of his lips and said nothing. He turned around and continued to choose the tie to wear today.

    An Lian stood nearby. Although she couldn't see it, she could sense what Ye Wenbai was doing.

    He moved slowly and unhurriedly. He first took out a dark blue tie and compared it. He seemed to be dissatisfied, then put it back, replaced it with a silver-grey one, and marked it on the collar.

    "Brother, are you going out today?" An Lian asked.

    "Well, I have a meeting in the morning." Ye Wenbai said while tying his tie, "I'll be back in the afternoon and have dinner with you."

    An Lian nodded obediently.

    Ye Wenbai tied up his tie, turned around and looked at An Lian.

    She stood there, wearing his coat, her hair a little messy, and her face still flushed from just waking up.

    The whole person looks lazy, like a satisfied kitten.

    Ye Wenbai helped her pull up the collar of her nightgown.

    The traces left by last night were a little too obvious.

    An Lian felt his movements, her cheeks turned red again, and she whispered, "It's all your fault."

    Ye Wenbai raised his eyebrows: "Blame me?"

    "Of course it's your fault." An Lian said confidently, "I said no more, but you still..."

    She couldn't speak any more and her voice became smaller and smaller.

    Ye Wenbai looked at her shy and annoyed look, felt very good, and reached out to rub the top of her hair.

    "Okay, okay, blame me." He said, "Be careful next time."

    An Lian snorted and turned her head away from him.

    Even though she couldn't see it.

    Ye Wenbai took back his hand, walked to the bed and sat down, patting the place next to him.

    "Come and sit."

    An Lian walked over slowly and sat down next to Ye Wenbai.
title_en: Chapter 15 She also has the burden of being a top student, okay?
